mapper.select:
(select #{audit} operation, operate_explaination explaination, create_date from t_experiment_plan_operation_record where experiment_id = #{planId} and is_deleted = 0 and operate_type in (#{audit}, #{failsAudit}) order by create_date desc limit 1)
union all
(select #{publish} operation, operate_explaination explaination, create_date from t_experiment_plan_operation_record where experiment_id = #{planId} and is_deleted = 0 and operate_type = #{publish} order by create_date desc limit 1)
union all
(select #{end} operation, operate_explaination explaination, create_date from t_experiment_plan_operation_record where experiment_id = #{planId} and is_deleted = 0 and operate_type = #{end} order by create_date desc limit 1)
union all
(select #{pause} operation, operate_explaination explaination, create_date from t_experiment_plan_operation_record where experiment_id = #{planId} and is_deleted = 0 and operate_type = #{pause} order by create_date desc limit 1)
